title: Nutty Fluffy Italian Rice Arancini
description: A kid-friendly Italian dish featuring umami flavors and fluffy rice, made with biryani masala and dairy-free friendly ingredients, formed into arancini.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped nuts and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add the biryani masala and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the marinara sauce and stir to combine.
Add the Italian rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce and nuts.
Transfer the rice mixture to a large bowl and let cool to room temperature.
Once the rice has cooled, stir in the vegan mozzarella shreds and chopped parsley.
Using your hands, shape the rice mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the arancini on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Bake the arancini in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly browned.
